dialog: Let me see what you've got.
Time to beat you down.
I'll confront you head-on!
You're just takin' it easy in the middle of a battlefield?
If you don't go full out/ you're gonna lose at the game of life.
I'm sorry to tell you/ but I'm not gonna hold back.
If you're gonna be that careless/ here comes the counterattack!
Looks like you really want to find out what dying feels like!
I'm not gonna blow this chance!
Thanks for saving me the bother.
If you leave me an opening/ I'm gonna take advantage of it!
I'm a youkai extermination professional.
Sorry/ but your time is now!
Blame this on the misfortune of crossing my path.
This might be a bit of a brute-force approach/ but let's go!
Taking a hit to get my cross-counter in... that's my style!
The last one left standing is the winner!
I'll show you how I can push through!
If you think this'll make me back off/ you're way off the mark.
It'd kill me if I don't die better than this!
I'll keep going till one of us dies!
Man/ I'm gonna be sore tomorrow...
This technique hurts like hell/ but whatever.
About time to settle this bout!
It's time for you to get fired up!
This is the power I received...
THIS is how I fight!
I'll show you what happens when I take you seriously.
Ha!
Give in!
You're through!
Hit them!
Drop dead!
You lowlife!
Take this!
Out of my way!
My claws can reach over there...
and shred you!
If you're gonna stand there/ then I'll do this...
and shred you!
I'll catch you out with this move!
You're through!
I'll clear the way with a single attack!
Out of my way!
Flames/ be my strength!
You're through!
Phoenix Wings...
RISE!
Just try and handle the flight of the phoenix!
Let's goooo!
Phoenix Wings...
RISE!
I'll burn you away with these flaming wings!
Raaaaaaa!
Phoenix Wings...
RISE!
Flames/ be my strength!
Let's go!
Phoenix Wings...
RISE!
Burn to ash under the wings of a phoenix!
You're through!
Phoenix Wings...
RISE!
Flare up!
I'm going in hard!
Using all my body!
You too...
You too... will turn red!
We'll burn together!
It's not over yet!
Raaaaaaagh!
You too...
You too... will turn red!
Ignition!
Eat this!
Raaaaaaah!
Fine Wind/ Clear Morning!
VOLCANO!
I'll use all my firepower!
We're just getting started!
Erupt!
Fujiyama...
VOLCANO!
I'll give everything I've got to the phoenix!
Soar on/
Phoenix!!!
Raaaaaaaah!
Burn into nothing!
And then...
It's time for the next life.
I won't let you get away.
Phoenix...
Soar!
Raaaaaaaah!
Burn into ashes!
And yet still...
I live on.
I'll show you my eternal flame!
Show me your power/
Phoenix!!!
Raaaaaaaah!
Engulf everything in flame!
And then...
It's time for the next life.
You stopped me. That takes moxie.
Only an amateur would rush back in here.
Enjoy having the upper hand while it lasts.
Can't believe I couldn't find a way to counter-attack...
What a softie.
That's amateurs for you...
Your end-game is trash/ switch with me!
That's amateurs for you...
You're so slow! What the heck are you even doing?
I'll burn them away in your memory!
If you don't back off/ you're gonna get caught up in this too!
I'll show you how it's done!
This is just picking off the weak/ but still...
Back off/ I got this!
I'm used to gettin' hurt by now.
If you don't wanna die/ beat it!
I'll follow your lead.
Let's decide this bout a little earlier.
I'll knock 'em down/ you stomp on them!
Don't hurt yourself trying to keep up with me.
It's a safe bet to aim at that one.
I'll draw the enemy's attention!
Let's not give 'em time to catch their breath!
If it's too tough for you/ I'll take your place.
I'll make an opening!
It's do-or-die!
We'll burn them to a crisp with our power!
We're gonna traumatise this poor sucker with our danmaku!
Just what did you do to Keine/ you little―
I'm Keine's backup!
Keine/ I've got this.
Keine/ I've got your back!
Keine/ watch out!
Finish them off for me/ okay?
Keine/ work your magic!
Keine/ I'll follow your instructions!
Keine/ let me hold them up for you.
Keine/ if it gets to be too much/ swap with me/ okay?
Keine/ let's get rid of them together!
Keine/ let's make some danmaku that'll go in the history books!
Keine/ I've got the follow-up.
Keine/ let's make some danmaku that'll go in the history books!
Eirin?! Well that's something you'd only see once in a blue moon...
That's Eirin for you/ does she know how to make a follow-up opportunity or what?
Eirin's already pulling back for me/ huh...
Eirin/ did you mess up your calculations?
Eirin/ is this part of one of your schemes?
Eirin/ this isn't like you at all!
Take careful aim with that oh-so-amazing planning of yours/ alright?
Eirin/ I'll keep 'em contained for you.
Eirin/ I'll finish them off a little early!
You can trust Eirin to always follow the plan. Her plan/ anyway...
Eirin/ you get what I'm going for/ right?
Eirin/ let's wipe them out together!
Eirin/ we're gonna traumatise this poor sucker with our danmaku!
Eirin/ let me put in the knockout blow for you!
Eirin/ I got this next!
Wh- What the hell were you thinking?! I'm gonna make you explain yourself later!
Kaguya/ I'll put them out of their misery now!
Kaguya/ that's just no good/ you've got to put them out of their misery sometime...
If you don't back off/ you're gonna get caught up in this too!
Kaguya/ there won't be a next time.
Kaguya/ what the hell are you doing just lazing around!
Fine/ I guess I've gotta fight alongside you.
Kaguya/ pay more attention to the battle!
I'll forgive ya for shooting at my back!
If I've gotta work hand-in-hand with you/ then I'm definitely not holding back!
Hey/ Kaguya/ let's pick a fight with this one.
Hey/ Kaguya―that one. You get my drift/ right?
Man/ why do I have to accept your help...
Kaguya/ let's wipe them out together!
Kaguya/ let's focus on this for now!
Man/ what a pain of an eternity this is...
Kaguya/ we're gonna traumatise this poor sucker with our danmaku!
For now/ I'll forgive you for shooting at my back!
As long as I'm still alive/ 's all good!
Ugh/ is this the toughest I can...
If I get cold feet here/ I'm done for...
Soon this body's going to break!
I was gonna die if that hit me...
Guess I outread you.
This doesn't even count as a real injury yet.
Yeah/ that's about what I expected.
I can just take this!
Oof/ not how I called it...
Guess that was my own fault.
Now I'm a little pissed off.
You might be fast/ but I'll show you I can keep up!
Looks like we got a battle-hardened one here.
Guess my read on you was off.
Just like this/ I lure them into my reach...
Taking a hit and keeping going is my thing.
Look at this/ you've got some real spirit in ya!
I think I'd get bored if I took you seriously.
Not dead yet!
Yeah/ you know your stuff.
Ow/ that smarts...\n But I can still keep going!
You'd need way more experience to take a shot at me!
This shows our difference in experience!
You want to take me down like that? Yeah/ that's not happening.
Sweating the small stuff isn't exactly my style...
Pointless to fully dodge it/ I guess.
You just gotta do this to dodge danmaku...
Watch your opponent closely... then the rest is based on many years of built up intuition.
It won't mean anything if you don't take good aim.
You could call me an old hand at this/ I guess.
Oh no/ so close! The stress is taking years off my lifespan!
Yeah/ nah.
I've done this enough times that I'm just bored with it.
This lone wolf's still got a little more howl in her!
I've had way more near-death scrapes than you.
You can't cut your opponent any slack like this.
Man/ there's some useful stuff around nowadays.
Piece of cake.
Nah.
Don't call me a coward for taking advantage of your mistakes!
I'll wipe you out before you attack!
What the―
Ah/ a familiar feeling...
That's it for me!
I can't do anymore.\n I'm backing off now.
Sorry/ but that's all I'm good for.\n I'm pulling back.
Ah/ a familiar feeling...
Woulda been nice to last longer...
Ugh/ this attack's just too much...
Alright/ let's make some grilled chicken!
You hurt Keine!
You bird-brains just don't learn/ do ya?
So these are Youkai Mountain's youkai...
I'm a youkai extermination professional.
How about I help you roast some sweet potatoes?
Dead leaves are pretty flammable.
You're one of the ones who drove off Keine! I'll get you for that!
Doesn't matter to me if you're some kind of misfortune god.
When it comes to who's had more misfortune happen to her/ I don't think I'd lose.
I'm here to get rid of people like you.
You're fast... but I can push myself hard enough to catch you!
I've never fought one of the big-league gods like you before...
Don't think you can just overawe me to win.
I've never fought one of the big-league gods like you before...
When it comes to who's accumulated more impurities/ I don't think I'm out of the running.
Never thought this would end up with me exterminating an Oni...
Guess you're one that the brute force approach won't work on.
I'll burn you up/ winter youkai!
I'll solve this incident for Keine and the others!
A fox youkai/ huh? Can't be too careful around you...
Feels like if I show you one weak point you'll have me...
I'm not gonna hold back/ of course.
If you're involved with this incident...
Your treasure won't work on me!
Once you're dead/ you don't come back. That's the rules of nature.
The Youkai Sage... finally/ a decent enemy.
Kaguya/ I'm putting an end to our rivalry!
Kaguya/ I'll kill you however many times it takes!
Agh! I won't let myself lose to you!
I'm not done! Not until I beat you!
Kaguya/ stop screwing around!
Kaguya/ I know for a fact that's not the best you can do!
Kaguya/ I'm ending this!
You might sneer at me/ but...
I've been living with people!
Your arrogance and your messed-up eternity will...
Burn into ashes!
Forming relationships with people/ and changing...
That's what it really means to be alive!
Out of the way/ Eirin!
I'll do this no matter how many times you get in my way/ Eirin!
Ugh/ I can't believe you're really gonna get in my way...
Not yet! Not until Kaguya's defeated!
Eirin/ it's not gonna go like last time!
Eirin/ is it just me or have your attacks gotten unoriginal?
Trying to conquer the surface? What the heck is your problem?!
Even if I've done this a lot before/ I still need to get in the right state of mind for diving into this level of firepower...
Ugh... A phoenix won't burn out so easily!
Guess I'd better prepare myself to get smoked a few times...
You sure telegraph your attacks.
Letting an animal tire itself out before you go in for the kill is just standard practice.
Alright/ I'll plunge into the flames like a phoenix!
Even I'm an inhabitant of the surface. To defend it/ you'll have to pit yourself against me!
I'm prepared for however many times this takes!
Physical pain is nothing compared to what's inside!
Seems like your material's not as fresh as it used to be...
Letting an animal tire itself out before you go in for the kill is just standard practice... but it looks like it's not gonna work here.
If we're gonna be diving into the sun...
with this body/ I can take flight!
Phoenix!
Raaaaaaaa!
Break through!
Your life...
... won't end here!
So you send death packing when ever it comes for you too? Nice.
Oh/ a stuck-up/ conceited enemy. I know the type.
You don't seem like you have much combat experience...
No matter what/ I'm not letting you slip away.
Alright/ no more doing whatever you want.
I'm gonna make some roast lamb.
Now we're doing the brute force approach? That's my specialty.
I've got a reason to keep fighting!
Don't you go pissing me off more than the current Kaguya does!
Alright/ let's make some grilled chicken!
Geez/ am I really THIS unfriendly...?
Bet we're both used to death!
Get lost or I'll make lamb flambé.
Don't abuse that power...
Guess you're just trying to stall us...
This just feels bad/ man.
All those dreams must mean you're pretty strong.
I'll come at you as many times as it takes!
I'm gonna resolve this incident and help out all the humans!
To help the humans/ I'll make sure your dreams go up in smoke!
All those dreams must mean you're pretty strong.
I'll come at you as many times as it takes!
I'm gonna take back our dreams and help out all the humans!
To help Makura/ I'll make sure your dreams go up in smoke!
Tengu/ Kenku/ I don't care what you are/ you're going down!
Hands off that human!
Hands off that human!
I'll show you the strength of my resolve!
Set my life ablaze!
EAT THIS!
I'll give you a hand!
Fujiyama...
VOLCANO!
